content:
**Hardy** is a second star armor and power armor legendary mod in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Milepost Zero* update.

Applying this mod will reduce received explosion damage by 7%. This effect stacks additively with itself, up to 35% total explosion damage reduction.

Since the effect reduces received damage from all explosions, it also reduces self inflicted damage. Hardy, Dense or Padded stack multiplicatively with hardy for up to 82.125% explosion damage reduction when 5 Hardy pieces are worn.
